install: set -eu; if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg jq; fi; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.revyl/bin/revyl" ]; then REVYL_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh -c 'curl -fsSL https://revyl.com/install.sh | sh'; fi; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.revyl/bin/revyl" /usr/local/bin/revyl; revyl version
